grade: 七年级上 ~ 七年级下
unit: Unit 3 / Unit 6 特殊疑问句专题
summary: 以疑问词（what / where / when / who / why / how...）开头的问句，不能用 Yes/No 回答。
signals: how much 问价格/不可数量

rules.title: 常见疑问词及用途
rules.detail: what（什么）where（哪里）when（何时）who（谁）whose（谁的）why（为什么）how（怎样）how many（多少-可数）how much（多少-不可数/价格）how often（多久一次）how long（多久/多长）。

examples.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

rules.title: 语序：疑问词 + 一般疑问句（助动词提前）
rules.detail: 有 be 动词直接把 be 提前：Where is he?；有实义动词要借助 do/does/did：What does she want?；疑问词作主语时语序不变：Who likes music?

examples.zh: 你爸爸是做什么工作的？

rules.title: how 词组的用法区分
rules.detail: how many + 可数名词复数；how much + 不可数名词 / 问价格；how often 问频率（回答 often, twice a week）；how long 问时间段或多长（回答 for two hours, 2 meters）。

examples.en: How often do you exercise? — Three times a week.
examples.zh: 你多久锻炼一次？——一周三次。

examples.en: How long did you stay there? — For two hours.
examples.zh: 你在那儿待了多久？——两个小时。

pitfalls: 忘记借助动词：❌ Where he lives? → ✓ Where does he live?
疑问词选错：问价格用 how much 不是 how many；问可数数量用 how many
Who 作主语时误加 does：❌ Who does like music? → ✓ Who likes music?

questions.explain: 问价格用 how much，回答 50 yuan。

questions.stem: — ___ do you go to the library? — Twice a month.
questions.explain: Twice a month（一月两次）表示频率，用 how often 提问。

questions.stem: — ___ does your brother do? — He is a doctor.
questions.explain: 问职业用 What does he do? 句型。
water 不可数用 how much；主语 you 是第二人称，借助动词用 do。

questions.stem: — ___ ___ is the river? — About 100 kilometers long. (two words: 多长)
questions.explain: 问长度/时间段用 how long。

questions.stem: ___ ___ students are there in your grade? (two words: 多少)
questions.explain: students 可数，问数量用 how many。
特殊疑问句中 does 已经体现三单，后面的动词还原为原形 live。

questions.stem: 你为什么喜欢熊猫？（翻译整句）
questions.explain: why + do + 主语 + 动词原形；panda 用复数表示类别。

questions.stem: 她通常几点去上学？（翻译整句）
answer: what time does she usually go to school?
when does she usually go to school?
questions.explain: 问具体时刻用 what time；does 后用动词原形 go。
